# Studio Kaku

> Studio Kaku is an art consultancy and custom framing studio in Tokyo, Japan. It curates, sources, frames and installs art for private collectors, companies, galleries and hotels, working in English and Japanese.

Studio Kaku was founded by Yuki Kakuno (framing, installation and art care; founder of the framing workshop Juka Framing) and Eleanor Ford Kakuno (art consultancy, creative direction and curation). Framing is done to museum standard with archival materials, in collaboration with Juka Framing (https://www.jukaframing.com). Clients and projects include Mitsui Fudosan (Sequence hotels in Kyoto and Tokyo), Soho House, Tokyo Creative Salon at Haneda Airport, Ceysson & Bénétière, the Tokyo American Club and Tokyo Gendai.

- Location: Tokyo, Japan. Projects across Japan.
- Languages: English and Japanese (Japanese site: https://studio-kaku.com/ja/)
- Contact: hello@studio-kaku.com, or the enquiry form at https://studio-kaku.com/contact/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/studio.kaku

## Services

- [Custom Art Framing in Tokyo](https://studio-kaku.com/services/framing/): Museum-standard custom framing in Tokyo for paintings, prints, photographs and works on paper. Archival materials, made in collaboration with Juka Framing.
- [Art Consultancy in Tokyo](https://studio-kaku.com/services/art-consultancy/): Art consultancy in Tokyo for collectors, companies and first-time buyers: curation, artist sourcing and commissions, acquisition advice, framing and installation.
- [Art Curation for Hotels in Japan](https://studio-kaku.com/services/hotel-art-curation/): Art curation and installation for hotels, ryokan and hospitality in Tokyo and across Japan. From a single lobby to a full property, with works by Japanese artists.
- [Art Installation & Hanging in Tokyo](https://studio-kaku.com/services/art-installation/): Art installation in Tokyo for homes, offices, galleries and exhibitions: transport, hanging and installation managed from start to finish, with one point of contact.
